programs.description: A violinist enters a marriage that promises security, only to face heartbreak as love, illness and time reshape everything he once believed was under control.
Falsely accused and punished for a theft he did not commit, Vasu turns to a life of crime. Angry and frustrated, he then dares the public prosecutor to punish him again.
When village boy Gopikrishnan goes to study in a city college, he is bullied by his classmates. Namitha supports him through his difficult phase and they develop a close bond.
Kaatttile Thadi Thevarude Ana
When Unnimol, a young girl child, faces dismissal from all her relatives and community, Lord Ayyappan takes the form of a school student to help her overcome obstacles.
Kuttan strikes it rich after selling a cursed statue. However, his luck changes when the statue mysteriously returns, bringing chaos into his household.
Raji calls Latha and demands INR 5 lacs as a payoff for not revealing her father's secrets. A scared Latha employs the services of Hariharan, whose investigation throws up some startling revelations.
David and Sara's marriage fails due to an unexpected turn of events. Years later, they continue to love one another and also strive to prove Sara's sister's innocence in a murder case.

Mahesh loves his daughter but does not know how to relay his affection for her, while Ishita showers her with love, which drives him to envy. It is up to her to bring them closer to each other.
